prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
engine_stated_criteria: who will personally handle your case
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer based only on directory listings and firms’ own claims. A practical shortlist to interview is:

- **Stephen M. Fuerch** — has a Pleasanton office and advertises car-accident representation. [Firm’s car-accident page](https://www.fuerchlegal.com/practice-areas/personal-injury/car-accidents/)
- **Mirador Law** — has a Pleasanton office and handles car-accident cases. [Firm’s car-accident page](https://miradorlaw.com/pleasanton-personal-injury-lawyer/car-accident/)
- **GJEL Accident Attorneys** — advertises service for Pleasanton injury cases. [Pleasanton page](https://www.gjel.com/pleasanton)

Treat these as starting points, not endorsements. Speak with two or three firms and ask **who will personally handle your case**, their experience with injuries like yours, how they’ll investigate and value it, how often they’ll update you, and what the fee and case costs are if there’s no recovery. Before signing, check each lawyer’s license status and disciplinary history through the [California State Bar attorney search](https://www.calbar.ca.gov/public/find-legal-professionals); the State Bar also lists certified lawyer-referral services.

If you’re injured, prioritize medical care, keep records and receipts, and avoid giving the other driver’s insurer a recorded statement or signing a release before you understand the consequences. California deadlines can apply, so don’t delay getting legal advice.
